definition: Estimates Stanene Topological Films readiness from component maturity.

definition: Simulates Stanene Topological Films operating for a day.
description:

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where stanene growth monitoring, film logistics redundancy, or topological gaps maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Stanene Topological Films Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Stanene Topological Films: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Stanene Topological Films — tin monolayers for quantum spin Hall.

Phase 1 — Prove (stanene growth): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (film logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (topological gaps): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (cryo tests): film hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and labs-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
